raw_tcp_ab.note: A->B echo round trip, persistent connection, TCP_NODELAY, 10 samples each
raw_tcp_ab.finding: 8 KiB is exactly one RTT. Above ~8 KiB the link is window-limited: 32 KiB costs 4 RTTs. This explains the prefill cost, not the decode cost.

root_cause_of_remaining_latency: The direct-return path still sent a 'done' acknowledgement back up the chain (C->B->A, ~620 ms) and stage A blocked on it. Under direct return that ack carries no information the client needs: the client is waiting on the reply channel. Making forwarding fire-and-forget removed it.

delayed_ack.evidence: 8 KiB round trip measured at 353.8 ms against a 311 ms RTT = 1.14x, i.e. one round trip. A delayed-ACK penalty would show 1.5-2x.
